newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firmer in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firmer in active trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly firmer in active trade on Friday, with spotlight on Zagrebacka Banka and food processor Podravka.
* Eight of 12 active issues rose, three fell and one remained flat.
* Volume almost doubled at 33,152 shares, turnover also higher at 12.5 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer Zagrebacka Banka rose 110 kuna to hit a new high of 1,870 kuna, after peaking at 1,900 earlier in the session. It sold 129 shares.
* Shipper Atlantska Plovidba was the top decliner, losing 78 kuna to 102 and selling 115 shares in a first deal since November.
* Most active Podravka edged up 13 kuna to 318 on volume of 26,863 shares.
